verdict.rationale: Flagsmith has a published pricing page at flagsmith.com/pricing that lists plan features such as SAML/SSO, 2FA, and unlimited feature flags and environments. However, nothing in the evidence shows price points or which unit drives cost (seats, MAUs, API requests, or events), so a PM could not judge spend before committing. Missing for 10: actual plan prices, documented cost drivers (seats, MAUs, requests, events), overage or usage-limit details, and independent corroboration of pricing clarity.
